thread:
maya: Hey infra team — onboarding a new tenant (acct 789012345678) for EU-West-2. They need p5 and g5 capacity and we also hit ENI limits during the dry-run. Can someone open quota requests for: p5.24xlarge = 8 -> 24, g5.48xlarge = 4 -> 12, ENIs per region bump 500 -> 2000?

ashwin: +1, we saw the ENI issue on the stress test yesterday. Did you capture the VPC/subnet details?

maya: Yes, VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d in eu-west-2. Subnets are the usual /20s. I ran `kubectl get nodes` on the test cluster — nodes flapping when we provision >10 pods that attach GPUs. Logs showed `ENI quota exceeded` errors.

govind: If we're requesting that many GPUs we'll also want to request EC2-instances quota (Running On-Demand G instances) — support sometimes separates them. Suggest opening two linked cases: one for Accelerators (p5/g5) and one for ENI/ElasticNetworkInterfaces.

maya: Good call. Drafting the support text now: ```Please increase the following quotas for account 789012345678 in eu-west-2: Accelerators: p5.24xlarge from 8 to 24; g5.48xlarge from 4 to 12. EC2 On-Demand instances: increase Running On-Demand G instance count accordingly. Networking: ENIs from 500 to 2000. Purpose: Production tenant onboarding for latency-sensitive inference. Expected sustained utilization: 1200 GPU-hours/week. Contact: maya@redwood.com.```

ashwin: Add a note asking for ENI allocation on the AZs we'll use (eu-west-2a/2b/2c) — support sometimes gives a regional total that ends up unevenly split.

maya: Added that. Also requesting burst capacity for first 4 weeks (30% burst) to avoid throttling during canary.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist:quota_request_template.md attached. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

govind: Once you have the case numbers, paste them here and tag cloudops. I'll prepare a short runbook to attach to the case showing expected traffic pattern and KV cache sizing — helps with approval.

sophie: FYI finance asked for an estimate of cost delta if approved. Rough numbers: p5 -> ~6x g5 cost; with requested counts expect ~+$85k/month raw infra. I'll drop a more precise calc after we see approval.

maya: Opening cases now. Linking them: Case 1234567890 (Accelerators + On-Demand instances), Case 1234567891 (ENI per AZ uplift). Sent support message and requested expedited review citing production onboarding.

ashwin: Nice. Can we also request a soft limit on instance launch concurrency for the account to reduce noisy neighbor launch storms?

maya: Done — added `InstanceLaunchConcurrency` request to case 1234567890.

deploy-bot: Automated note: Quota request docs updated in #eng-infra > see pinned message.

govind: Track the approvals in the onboarding spreadsheet and flag if support asks for architecture diagrams. We should proactively include the k8s CNI and ENI allocation plan.

maya: Will do. Closing the thread here once we get case updates. Thanks all :thumbsup:
